# Default disabled optional features in kc.toml

The kc.toml template written by write_config sets optional plugin features to disabled by default: publisher.enabled = false, llm.enabled = false, embeddings.enabled = false (activation is explicit).

Make activation of optional components explicit by shipping a configuration file that disables them by default.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/bootstrap.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.bootstrap.write_config`
